title: [DocDB] Vector index search hangs when the base table is split before vector index creation
body:
Jira Link: [DB-19237](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-19237)
### Description

Step to reproduce:
```
1. Create cluster with RF=1
2. yugabyte=# CREATE EXTENSION vector;
3. yugabyte=# CREATE TABLE test (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, embedding vector(1)) split into 1 tablets;
4. yugabyte=# INSERT INTO test SELECT i, ARRAY[i] FROM generate_series(0, 19) as i;
5. Flush the only tablet
6. Split the only tablet
7. Wait enough time (for example till parent tablet cleanup)
8. yugabyte=# CREATE INDEX ON test USING ybhnsw (embedding vector_l2_ops);
9. Try search: yugabyte=# SELECT * FROM test ORDER BY embedding <-> '[10.0]' limit 5;
```
The last request (step 9) is stuck until timeout, yb-tserver generates the following logs:
```
W1121 13:59:58.378463 2526370 meta_cache.cc:975] 0x000071aefced36d8 -> GetTableLocations { table_name: yugabyte.test [ysql_schema=public] [000034d40000300080000000000040fa], table_id: 000034d40000300080000000000040fa, partition_start_key: Pgsql Hash, partition_list_version: 1, request_no: 2307, num_attempts: 1 }: Operation failed. Try again (yb/client/meta_cache.cc:1132): Received table 000034d4000030008000000000004100 partitions version: 1, MetaCache's table partitions version: 0: kTablePartitionListIsStale (client error 1)

Try again (yb/client/meta_cache.cc:1132): Received table 000034d4000030008000000000004100 partitions version: 1, MetaCache's table partitions version: 0: kTablePartitionListIsStale (client error 1)
W1121 14:00:00.378901 2526370 meta_cache.cc:975] 0x000071aefceae8d8 -> GetTableLocations { table_name: yugabyte.test [ysql_schema=public] [000034d40000300080000000000040fa], table_id: 000034d40000300080000000000040fa, partition_start_key: Pgsql Hash, partition_list_version: 1, request_no: 6879, num_attempts: 1 }: Operation failed. Try again (yb/client/meta_cache.cc:1132): Received table 000034d4000030008000000000004100 partitions version: 1, MetaCache's table partitions version: 0: kTablePartitionListIsStale (client error 1)
...
W1121 14:01:01.908737 2526370 client_master_rpc.cc:74] Failed to determine new Master: Timed out (yb/rpc/outbound_call.cc:793): Call timed out before sending
I1121 14:01:01.913144 2526382 client_master_rpc.cc:88] 0x000071aefceae8d8 -> GetTableLocations { table_name: yugabyte.test [ysql_schema=public] [000034d40000300080000000000040fa], table_id: 000034d40000300080000000000040fa, partition_start_key: Pgsql Hash, partition_list_version: 1, request_no: 1271256, num_attempts: 2 }: Failed: Timed out (yb/rpc/rpc.cc:224): GetTableLocations { table_name: yugabyte.test [ysql_schema=public] [000034d40000300080000000000040fa], table_id: 000034d40000300080000000000040fa, partition_start_key: Pgsql Hash, partition_list_version: 1, request_no: 6879, num_attempts: 2 } passed its deadline 15176411.513s (passed 0.003s of 0.000s): Timed out (yb/rpc/outbound_call.cc:793): Call timed out before sending
```
Cluster restart resolve the issue.
